prior_art_and_role: Classical phase-amplitude registration and Schur projection; simple lag correction, smoothing and displacement scaling.

inputs: fixed endpoint-preserving phase and amplitude bases
original time IDs, derivative bounds, positive amplitude ridge
outputs: full original-identity mesh sequence at every original frame

planned_math_to_code.statement: Linearize the repair as r approximately P xi+B gamma, with phase endpoint offsets zero.
Let M=I-P(P^T W P)^dagger P^T W; after unconstrained phase elimination, gamma*=(B^T W M B+lambda I)^-1 B^T W M r.
For monotone time, impose 1+tau'(t)>0; if the bound is active, solve the full constrained block problem instead of the unconstrained formula.
Overlapping phase/amplitude directions are unidentifiable without extra constraints; residual second-order error is O(||tau||^2).

native_experiment.distinguishing_prediction: Timing-dominated errors should respond to phase correction while amplitude-only shrinkage loses motion; amplitude-dominated errors should show the opposite pattern.
native_experiment.falsifier: Reject if ordinary lag/alignment with equal evidence/budget is sufficient, or phase/amplitude remains unidentifiable on the native task.
